args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west); error rate was 0.18 and health status was unhealthy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues; investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9 before it) were healthy.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was needed — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
